content: At inference time, we gather the output logits of word-initial wordpieces only. Since the number of word-initial wordpieces is the same for $\mathcal {T}_\mathrm {LM}(S)$ and $\hat{\mathcal {T}}_\mathrm {LM}(S)$, this makes mean-pooling the logits straightforward.
